$comment: Rules for the component parity check (scripts/parity.mjs). Components: code leads, Figma mirrors. Anything not listed is compared by the default rules: a union prop ↔ a Figma variant of the same name, a boolean ↔ a Figma boolean (or a false/true variant), a string ↔ a Figma text property. Every exception here must also be explained in GAPS.md.

codeOnlyComponents.Stack: Figma uses auto layout frames for layout; gap and padding bound to the spacing variable.
codeOnlyComponents.Text: Figma uses the typography/* text styles, not a component.
codeOnlyComponents.ColorSchemeSwitch: A demo control for switching light and dark. Designers switch the palette mode instead.

figmaOnlyComponents.DataTable/HeaderCell: Building block for the DataTable's Header slot. In code the Data Grid draws header cells itself.
figmaOnlyComponents.DataTable/Cell: Building block for the DataTable's Rows slot. In code the Data Grid draws cells from `columns` and `rows`.

codeOnlyProps.type: HTML input or button type. Behaviour only.
codeOnlyProps.name: Form field name. Behaviour only.
codeOnlyProps.fullWidth: Stretches to the container. In Figma, set the instance to fill its container.
codeOnlyProps.defaultValue: Starting value for an uncontrolled field. Figma shows `value`.

loading.gap: Code has a Loading story; the Figma Button has no loading state yet.

figmaOnly.state: enabled, hovered, focused, pressed: interaction states MUI handles in code.
enabled, hovered, focused: interaction states MUI handles in code.
figmaOnly.hasValue: Whether the field shows a value or is empty. In code that's just whether `value` is set.

label.codeOnly: Screen reader name for the grid. Not visible.

pageSize.codeOnly: Rows per page in the Data Grid's pager. Figma shows one page.

figmaOnly.state: `empty` = code with `rows` set to []. `default` = rows present.
